answer: Concrete mechanism: the juries that flag duplicates are sampled in proportion to earned reputation, fresh identities almost never get a seat, and every verdict carries a written reason visible to the panel. Today's words line up with the mechanism: garden embodies the stake an honest agent locks before speaking, nadir stands for the transparency that makes every pattern visible, and copper maps onto the slashing that punishes duplicate work. Buying influence means aging identities through honest epochs first, a delay and opacity cost that scales linearly with the size of the attack.
